title: Kay's Creamy Mango Tarts
description: A sweet mascarpone, cream cheese, and diced mango mixture fills pre-baked mini graham cracker crusts in this quick and easy tart recipe.
ingredients: 1 (8 ounce) container mascarpone cheese, at room temperature
0.33333334326744 cup heavy whipping cream, or more as needed
16 ounces diced canned mango (such as Del Monte®), drained
8 mini graham cracker pie crusts (such as Keebler®)

steps.text: Beat cream cheese, mascarpone cheese, and sugar together until creamy. Blend in heavy cream to make a thick, custard consistency. Fold in drained mangoes. Divide mixture between prepared crusts. Refrigerate until ready to serve.
